title: Hearty German Fennel Gratin
description: A floral, creamy quick-fix German dish that layers thinly sliced fennel, carrot, and onion with yuzu zest, enriched with heavy cream and Gouda, topped with crusty bread for a satisfying vegetarian dinner.
instructions: Slice the fennel bulb, carrot, and onion into thin ribbons.
Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat and sauté the vegetables until fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook another minute.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and let it thicken slightly, about 10 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream, yuzu zest, salt, and pepper, and cook for 3 minutes.
Remove from heat, sprinkle shredded gouda cheese, and fold in crusty bread slices to soak up the sauce.
Transfer the mixture back to the Dutch oven, cover, and bake for 15 minutes, then uncover and bake for another 5 minutes until golden.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
Serve hot as a comforting vegetarian dinner.
